# Viraj Patel

> Personal site and interactive portfolio for Viraj Patel (angrybayblade), a software engineer in Bengaluru, India.

Viraj builds developer platforms, SDKs, orchestration systems, and open-source infrastructure. The site presents his resume and personal collections through a desktop-style interface.

- [Full profile and experience](/llms-full.txt)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/angrybayblade)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/angrybayblade/)

## Site sections

- [About](/about): Introduction and profile links
- [Resume](/resume): Professional summary, experience, impact, and skills
- [Movies](/movies), [music](/music), [comics](/comics), [anime](/anime), [books](/books), and [vines](/vines): Personal media collections

Private editing and API routes are not intended for indexing.
